heading: **24 February 2026**
body:
*NCFS Sample clean-up and quantification*

Ratio of AmpureXP beads used for clean-up ⇒ 1.5X

lig147NCFS \= \~1.5 ng/uL

ligN40NCFS \= \~0.2 ng/uL

*lig50k sample preparation* 

For 1 ug of the lig50k DNA, use the first condition to produce 20 kb fragments

***![](assets/img/doc3-image14.png)***

*sol1 dried salt plates*

**sol1 Salt solution: 2M KCl\_1.491g KCl \+ 10mL TE \+ cocktail Tablet \+ 1mM TCEP**

50 mL X 2

| KCl | 7.46 g |
| :---- | :---- |
| 100 mM TCEP | 0.5 mL |
| TE Buffer (100X) | 0.5 mL |
| EDTA-free protease inhibitor | 1 tablet |

Filter, mix well and aliquot. Add 130 uL per well of 2 X  4titude 96-well plates. Use one plate for making 6 384-well NUNC plate aliquots.
